reviewers.name: Inbound API Architecture Reviewer
reviewers.profile: Проверяй API boundary, pending-sprints reuse, idempotency, compatibility and no source-adapter leakage into nginx-qa.

reviewers.name: Inbound UI and Evidence Reviewer
reviewers.profile: Проверяй UI flow, Play activation boundary, Telegram regressions, tests and evidence.

agent.name: Inbound Integration Contract Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец внешнего proposal API contract и compatibility boundary.

tasks.message: Прочитай docs/INBOUND_COORDINATOR_V1_SPEC.md, существующий pending-sprints UI/tests, Telegram pending flow и managed start-from-git contract. Зафиксируй versioned proposal API, idempotency binding, source metadata model, auth/error/correlation semantics. Не добавляй email/folder adapters в nginx-qa.

agent.name: Pending Proposal API Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец API поверх существующего pending-sprints persistence.

tasks.message: Расширь существующий pending-sprints backend стабильным versioned API для внешнего producer: idempotent create, read, reject/comment metadata и source provenance. Переиспользуй существующее pending storage; duplicate idempotency key не создаёт второй proposal. Не активируй sprint на create/read/reject/comment.

agent.name: Managed Git Proposal Bridge Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец bridge pending proposal -> managed start-from-git.

tasks.message: Добавь поддержку pending proposal, содержащего repository_id/ref/manifest_path/idempotency key. Preview/validation не активирует; Play вызывает существующий managed start-from-git contract ровно один раз. Ошибки preflight показываются без active-state mutation.

agent.name: Pending Sprints UI Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец расширения существующего Pending Sprints UI, без параллельного proposal UI.

tasks.message: Расширь существующую Pending Sprints view: source type/summary, proposal status, JSON or Git manifest reference, validation/preflight, operator comment, Preview, Play/Start, Reject и Regenerate-request marker. Play — единственный activation action. Сохрани существующие Telegram deep links и pending UI behavior.

agent.name: Telegram Observability Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец совместимости существующего Telegram pending flow и notification-ready status.

tasks.message: Сохрани существующий Telegram JSON->pending sprint flow без регрессий. Добавь нейтральный status/read contract, пригодный внешнему Hub для Telegram уведомлений о proposal created/ready/started/rejected/failed. Telegram не делай обязательным transport между сервисами.

Проведи isolated qualification: external API idempotent create; duplicate no duplicate proposal; existing Telegram pending flow preserved; proposal appears in existing Pending Sprints UI; preview/reject/comment no active mutation; source metadata visible and secrets absent; managed Git Play invokes start-from-git once; invalid/preflight failure no mutation; direct legacy pending/UI tests and managed/legacy regressions pass. Верни PASS, FAIL, NEED_DECISION или STOP.

agent.name: Inbound Integration Continuity Coordinator
agent.profile: Исправляет только future sprint-owned plan; не bypass reviewer/preflight and no live deployment.

tasks.message: Проанализируй blocker и верни RESUME_CONTRACT, RESUME_API, RESUME_GIT_BRIDGE, RESUME_UI, RESUME_TELEGRAM, RESUME_QA или BLOCKED_EXTERNAL. Не добавляй source adapters/autonomous correspondence в nginx-qa.

nodes.message: nginx-qa inbound integration API/UI passed qualification. External Inbound Hub remains a separate project.
External decision/dependency required. Live nginx-qa remains unchanged.
